purpose: Append-only B qualification/lifecycle projection; original Program A decision and snapshot V1 records remain immutable.

envelope.persistence: SQLite append-only per-state revision chain with digest and previous-digest binding

migration.behavior: Create a sidecar state envelope from each existing immutable decision if no B envelope exists; never rewrite/delete V1 records.

transition_safety.SOURCE_BLOCKED: Append-only non-actionable state; cannot activate or re-arm an episode.
transition_safety.UNKNOWN: Append-only unknown state; no neutral imputation or outcome inference.
